title: rebuild.sh installs dependencies before packaging
notes: scripts/rebuild.sh runs pnpm run package with whatever node_modules holds; after #156 added yaml, a rebuild from a checkout installed earlier failed to resolve it. Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile before pnpm run package, on every OS (#325 added the Windows path). A lockfile out of date stops the rebuild with pnpm's message; the installed build stays untouched. Update the rebuild docs and .claude/commands/rebuild.md if they describe the steps.
